annotation.justification: The clause is clear and unambiguous. It specifies that a server must treat the receipt of a GOAWAY frame on any stream as a connection error of type HTTP_FRAME_UNEXPECTED. There is no ambiguity in the requirement or in the conditions under which it applies.
